{{Quote|How is mother?''"<br />"''She is well. Missing you, but proud of what you are doing.|Vestara Khai asking her father, Gavar, about her mother, Lahka|<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>}}
'''Lahka Khai''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. She married the [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]], with whom she had one child, [[Vestara Khai|Vestara]]. Lahka, unlike her husband and daughter, was not [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. In [[41 ABY]], Vestara was chosen to be the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea|Rhea]], causing her to move away from her family and live in the [[Kesh Sith Temple|Sith Temple]]. When Vestara was [[43 ABY|later]] sent on a [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|mission]] to confront the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], Lahka Khai remained in good health, although she missed her daughter. Lahka was present with Gavar when the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]] arrived on Kesh in [[44 ABY]], after Abeloth proposed an alliance with the Sith to defeat the Jedi. However, that evening, Abeloth unleashed an [[Destruction of Tahv|attack]] on the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]], leaving it in ruins and [[Death/Legends|killing]] many of its residents, Lahka included.

==Biography==
[[File:GavarKhai-Allies.jpg|thumb|left|145px|Gavar Khai, Lahka's husband]]
{{Quote|Sometimes I think she is truly my daughter, a fierce and proud Sith, as I have trained her to be. And sometimes I think she is on the verge of betraying all of us.''"<br />"''Not our Vestara. She knows her duty. To the dark side, to the Sith, to the Lost Tribe, to us. Even if she falters, I have faith she will not truly fall from the path.|Gavar and Lahka, discussing their daughter|<ref name="Ascension" />}}
Lahka Khai was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] born on<ref name="Omen" /> the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Despite her lack of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]], she married a [[Sith Saber]], [[Gavar Khai]]&mdash;a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]],<ref name="Omen" /> descendants of a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] whose [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Omen]]'', crashed onto the planet in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].<ref name="Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]''</ref> Together, the Khais lived in a private [[Khai estate|estate]] on Kesh.<ref name="Ascension" />

With Gavar, Lahka gave birth to one daughter in [[27 ABY/Legends|27.5 ABY]], whom they named [[Vestara Khai|Vestara]]. Vestara began [[Sith training|training]] in the ways of the Sith, and shortly after [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]], arrived on the planet in [[41 ABY]], she was called to meet with the [[Circle of Lords]] in Kesh's [[Circle Chambers]], in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]]. Gavar and Vestara were worried that she might have gotten in trouble, and, though Lahka could tell that something was wrong, she knew it was not her place to be concerned about Sith business. However, at the meeting, Vestara was chosen to become the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea|Rhea]]. To begin her training, Vestara had to move away from her family and live in the [[Kesh Sith Temple|Sith Temple]] located in the nearby [[Takara Mountains]].<ref name="Omen" />

In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], Vestara was chosen to be a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|Sith strike team]] sent to [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|confront]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]].<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref> She was the sole survivor of the mission, and went on to recruit a group of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to the Tribe's cause. Gavar, too, left on a [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] to find Vestara and then make a feigned alliance with the Jedi to attack the dark side entity [[Abeloth]]. Throughout that time, Lahka Khai remained in good health. She missed her daughter's presence, but she was also very proud of Vestara's achievements.<ref name="Allies" />

In [[44 ABY]], Gavar returned to Kesh with Abeloth, who&mdash;after multiple battles between herself, the Sith, and the Jedi&mdash;had proposed an alliance with the Sith to defeat the Jedi. He was able to take some time to meet with Lahka and live with her at their estate for a few days. Lahka then joined Gavar and the majority of the Sith in the Tribe in attending Abeloth's arrival planetside at the [[Tahv spaceport]]. Later that evening Lahka returned to their estate while Gavar attended a masquerade for Abeloth to which Lahka had not been invited. Gavar spent the night on his [[ChaseMaster]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], the ''[[Black Wave]]'', rather than returning home; and in the night Abeloth unleashed a powerful [[Destruction of Tahv|attack]] on the city, leaving much of Tahv in ruins and [[Death/Legends|destroying]] many of its inhabitants. Despite the fact that Lahka was among those who died, Gavar chose to betray the Tribe and ally with Abeloth.<ref name="Ascension" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Vestara-Ascension.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Vestara Khai, Lahka's daughter]]
{{Quote|You are worried about our daughter.''"<br />"''And you tell people you aren't Force-sensitive.''"<br />"''I am Gavar-sensitive, which is perhaps even better.|Lahka and Gavar|<ref name="Ascension" />}}
Lahka was intelligent, patient, and adept at keeping secrets&mdash;and those reasons made up for her lack of Force-sensitivity in Gavar's [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. She was also capable of reading some of Gavar's emotions.<ref name="Ascension" /> Lahka did not fully understand the matters of the Lost Tribe of Sith, but she knew that it was not her place to interfere in their affairs. As such, she did not ask questions of her husband and daughter when they became troubled by Vestara being called to the Circle Chambers.<ref name="Omen" /> She missed her daughter when Vestara traveled off-planet on a mission to kill the Skywalkers, but she was proud of Vestara's accomplishments.<ref name="Allies" /> When Gavar told her of Vestara's developing relationship with Ben Skywalker, Lahka suggested that Ben could prove a powerful asset to the Tribe and their family if Vestara swayed him, and when Gavar responded with his fear that Ben might sway her, Lahka stated her faith that Vestara would never betray her family, the Tribe, or the dark side.<ref name="Ascension" />

Lahka was partial to the [[Sith Victory]] flower, and happily crushed them during Abeloth's celebration in order to enjoy their scent. She was exceptionally beautiful&mdash;as attractive as the native [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] women&mdash;and had a soft smile.<ref name="Ascension" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lahka Khai was created by author [[Christie Golden]] for her first ''[[Star Wars]]'' novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'', the second of nine novels in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, released [[July 23]], [[2009]]. She received brief mention in the fifth and sixth novels, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'' and ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]'', respectively, before making an appearance in [[2011]]'s ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]'', the eighth novel of the series.
